text:
Sam (People Ops): Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-up: deck + recording below, and a short list of clarifications and owners. Please reply if you disagree with owners or ETA. Deck: https://redwood.internal/docs/all-hands-may24.pdf Recording: https://meetings.redwood/rec/ah-2024-05-20 TL;DR: Dedicated GA targeted end of Q2; priorities called out were runtime reliability, Dedicated autoscale, and private deploy onboarding. Action items below.

Diego (CTO): Confirming Dedicated GA goal ~2024-06-28 (end Q2). Main infra action: finalize autoscaler A/B config and run perf tests. @Leah can you own autoscaler tests? Ticket INF-3421.

Leah (Eng Lead): I can own autoscaler tests. ETA 2 weeks for baseline perf runs. I'll post results to #eng-runtime and link here. :thumbsup: 

Jia (VP Product): For model rollouts: product asks we define canary -> ramp -> full steps and rollback criteria. @Omar please attach the eval suite we used for the demo so PMs can reuse.

Omar (ML): Uploading evals: https://artifacts.redwood/ml/evals-demo.zip Note: current eval highlights latency vs quality tradeoffs per quantization profile. I'll add a short README. Owners: ML to maintain evals, PM to own prompt sets. Also, we should add a 'quality regression' alert to Console. Ticket ML-1287.

Marisol (PM): I'll own prompt sets and tie them to regression alerts. Meeting to sync? I'm free Wed 10–11 PT. I'll create invite and attach to INF-3421 and ML-1287.

FinanceBot: FYI: projected Hosted usage credit for new signups increased by ~8% after the demo. If Dedicated GA hits expectations, model 10–15% increase in committed spend for Q3. See spreadsheet: https://finance.redwood/projections/q3-dedicated.xlsx

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled for canary: infra-autoscaler:v2 -> canary pool at 2024-05-22T18:00Z. Command to check canary logs:
```
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=autoscaler -f --since=1h
```

Ava (CEO): Thanks — love the clear owners. Two asks: (1) make sure customer-facing messaging around Dedicated GA highlights SLA and migration guide; @Marisol can you draft? (2) prioritize 'rollback fast' in the rollout checklist. Will review INF-3421 on Friday.

Sam (People Ops): Great — updating the follow-up doc and action tracker. I'll ping owners individually and update the thread when invites + tickets linked. Thanks all! :sparkles:
